request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real skin, fur, fabric and landscape texture, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Image 1 shows Ana: about thirty, long wavy black hair, an olive-green button shirt open over a white top. Keep her face, hair and clothes exactly. Create a NEW photograph: Ana sits comfortably on a park bench on a mild sunny day; she has taken off a light jacket, which lies folded beside her on the bench, and she turns her face up to the gentle sun with closed eyes and a relaxed smile, sleeves rolled up. She is pleasantly WARM: not sweating or hot, and not cold. Green trees behind her. Exactly one person. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
